experiment: C14 exploratory basis robustness of half-interface self-anchored Canaria alignment
interpretation: All 12 prospectively fixed model-seed x basis combinations improved over the frozen hierarchy.
Identity-coordinate and three independent random orthogonal half-interface bases showed the same qualitative behavior.
Final NMSE relative to full-64 alignment ranged from about 1.092x to 1.165x.
Within-model basis sensitivity was small in this exploratory cohort: worst/best NMSE spread was at most about 1.050x.
This is exploratory and does not establish arbitrary-subspace invariance.
